what: As the board right behind rises from the bottom of the screen, the inside of this board moves down 150px around its bottom center and shrinks to .9x, and a black veil of (fraction of screen risen × .5 − .2) is laid over the board — a round board transition where the next section presses down and sinks the previous one as it covers it. Past 1.4 times the height of the board behind, nothing changes further.

options.drop: Distance (px) it drops once a full screen has scrolled up, default 150
options.min: Smallest shrink scale, default .9 (.1 per screen)
options.shade: Veil darkness after one full screen has scrolled up, default .5
options.offset: Value subtracted from curtain opacity — the curtain is invisible for this much at first, default .2
options.stop: How many times the back panel’s height to travel before stopping, default 1.4
options.[data-fx-part=content]: Inner part that gets pressed down (required). A veil (::before) is laid over the panel itself

from.where: index.html .ty-mv (interview panel covers the hero stage) · .ty-foot__midwrap on every page (charcoal base panel covers the Entry panel) · service.html .ty-svc__top · .ty-svc__jobs (three panels in sequence)

note: A panel covered by the sibling element right after it — that panel is placed above this one with position and z-index. The original sets the travel distance in px regardless of screen size
